description: Distributed cache node applies invalidation messages without version checking, allowing stale messages to evict newer writes.
spec_notes: CacheNode.on_invalidation must verify msg.version >= curr_ver before clearing cache entry.

"""Inter-node cache invalidation protocol messages."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any


@dataclass
class InvalidationMessage:
    sender_id: str
    key: str
    version: int
repo_files.cluster.py:
"""Distributed cluster orchestrator."""

from typing import List
from cache_node import CacheNode
from invalidation_bus import InvalidationBus


class CacheCluster:
    def __init__(self, node_count: int = 3):
        self.bus = InvalidationBus()
        self.nodes = [CacheNode(f"node_{i}", self.bus) for i in range(node_count)]

tests.test_cache_coherence.py:
from cluster import CacheCluster
from message import InvalidationMessage


def test_peer_invalidation_broadcast():
    cluster = CacheCluster(node_count=3)
    n0, n1, n2 = cluster.nodes
    # Pre-populate all nodes
    n0.store["k1"] = "val0"
    n1.store["k1"] = "val0"
    n2.store["k1"] = "val0"

    # n0 updates k1 to version 2
    n0.put("k1", "val_v2", 2)
    assert n0.get("k1") == "val_v2"
    # Peers n1 and n2 must have had k1 invalidated
    assert n1.get("k1") is None
    assert n2.get("k1") is None


def test_stale_invalidation_message_ignored():
    cluster = CacheCluster(node_count=2)
    n0, n1 = cluster.nodes
    # n0 writes version 5
    n0.put("k2", "fresh_data", 5)
    assert n0.get("k2") == "fresh_data"
    # Stale out-of-order broadcast from past version 3 arrives at n0
    n0.on_invalidation(InvalidationMessage("n1", "k2", version=3))
    # Fresh data at version 5 MUST NOT be evicted by stale version 3 message!
    assert n0.get("k2") == "fresh_data"
    assert n0.versions["k2"] == 5


def test_equal_version_invalidation_applies():
    cluster = CacheCluster(node_count=2)
    n0, n1 = cluster.nodes
    n0.store["x"] = 100
    n0.versions["x"] = 2
    n0.on_invalidation(InvalidationMessage("n1", "x", version=2))
    assert n0.get("x") is None


def test_independent_keys_unaffected():
    cluster = CacheCluster(node_count=2)
    n0, n1 = cluster.nodes
    n0.put("key_a", "A", 1)
    n0.put("key_b", "B", 1)
    n1.put("key_a", "A_updated", 2)
    assert n0.get("key_a") is None
    assert n0.get("key_b") == "B"
